title: Senior Statutory Compliance & Taxation Executive
description:
**Senior Statutory Compliance & Taxation Executive**

**Department:**
Taxation & Statutory Compliance

**Experience Required:**
Minimum 3–5 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Work Location:**
On-site

**Reporting To:**
Compliance Manager / Management

**Job Purpose**

CLA Accounting Services is looking for an experienced and independent
**Senior Statutory Compliance & Taxation Executive**
to handle end-to-end statutory filings, taxation compliance, and regulatory submissions for multiple clients.

The primary responsibility of this role is to ensure timely, accurate, and complete filing of GST returns, TDS returns, income tax returns, PF, ESI, and other applicable statutory returns.

The candidate must have hands-on portal filing experience, be capable of independently handling compliance requirements, coordinate directly with clients, visit client premises whenever required, and ensure all statutory deadlines are met.

**This position is focused on statutory filings and compliance. Day-to-day accounting, bookkeeping, and routine accounting entries are not part of the primary responsibilities.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. GST Compliance and Filing**

* Prepare and file GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, annual returns, and other applicable GST returns.
* Handle GST registrations, amendments, LUT applications, and related compliance procedures.
* Verify GST data, input tax credit, and relevant reconciliations before filing.
* Handle GST notices, departmental queries, and compliance follow-ups.
* Monitor GST due dates and maintain client-wise filing records.

**B. TDS Compliance and Filing**

* Calculate and verify TDS deductions under applicable provisions.
* Prepare and file quarterly TDS returns, including Forms 24Q, 26Q, and other applicable returns.
* Handle TDS challan verification, corrections, defaults, and reconciliation through TRACES.
* Prepare and issue Form 16 and Form 16A, as applicable.
* Follow up with clients for TDS data, payments, and supporting documents.

**C. Income Tax Return Filing**

* Prepare and file income tax returns for individuals, proprietors, partnership firms, and other assigned entities.
* Handle tax computations, advance tax calculations, and applicable tax reconciliations.
* Review Form 26AS, AIS, TIS, and supporting financial information.
* Handle income tax portal submissions, return corrections, and applicable responses to notices.
* Coordinate with clients and senior professionals for complex tax matters.

**D. PF and ESI Compliance**

* Prepare and complete monthly PF and ESI compliance filings.
* Handle EPFO and ESIC portal activities, contribution details, and applicable payment procedures.
* Manage employee additions, exits, KYC updates, and related statutory requirements.
* Handle ECR preparation, contribution verification, and compliance follow-ups.
* Coordinate with clients regarding payroll inputs, employee records, notices, and inspections.

**E. Other Statutory and Regulatory Filings**

* Handle professional tax, labour welfare fund, and other applicable state-level statutory filings, depending on client requirements.
* Manage applicable annual statutory returns and renewal-related compliance.
* Track changes in statutory due dates, filing procedures, and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate with the Compliance Manager or authorized professional for additional filings, audits, and specialized compliance matters.

**F. Client Coordination and On-Site Compliance**

* collect statutory data, payroll information, tax documents, and supporting records.
* Coordinate directly with client accounts teams, HR teams, management, and authorized representatives.
* Independently follow up for pending documents, approvals, challan payments, and filing confirmations.
* Maintain a client-wise statutory compliance calendar and filing tracker.
* Share filing acknowledgements, challan details, and compliance status reports with clients and management.
* Identify compliance gaps, pending liabilities, notices, and potential penalties and escalate them promptly.

**What This Role Will NOT Cover**

* Routine day-to-day bookkeeping.
* Regular purchase and sales accounting entries.
* Routine voucher posting and transaction recording.
* Daily bank entry posting and general ledger maintenance.
* Full-time responsibility for maintaining clients' books of accounts.

The candidate may review accounting reports and reconciliations where necessary to complete statutory filings accurately.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Com or M.Com preferred.
* Relevant taxation, accounting, or statutory compliance qualifications are an advantage.
* Strong practical knowledge of Indian tax and statutory compliance requirements is essential.

**Minimum Experience and Skills**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant hands-on experience in statutory compliance and taxation.
* Preferably 4–5 years of experience handling GST, TDS, PF, ESI, and income tax filings.
* Prior experience in a CA firm, tax consultancy, accounting services firm, or compliance outsourcing company preferred.
* Experience handling multiple clients and independently managing statutory due dates is essential.
* Prior client-site visits and direct client coordination experience are mandatory.

**Required technical knowledge:**

* GST portal
* Income Tax e-Filing portal
* TRACES portal and TDS return utilities
* EPFO and ESIC portals
* Professional tax and applicable state compliance portals
* Excel and statutory compliance tracking

* Timely filing of all assigned statutory returns.
* Accuracy of returns and supporting calculations.
* Zero avoidable late filings or penalties attributable to the employee.
* Timely completion of client follow-ups and document collection.
* Proper maintenance of filing acknowledgements and compliance records.
* Effective handling of statutory notices and compliance discrepancies.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a hands-on taxation and statutory compliance professional who can independently manage multiple clients' filing requirements, work directly with clients at their premises, coordinate with relevant departments, and ensure that all statutory obligations are completed accurately and within prescribed deadlines.

**Designation:**
Senior Statutory Compliance & Taxation Executive

**Minimum Experience:**
3 years; preferably 4–5 years

**Core Function:**
End-to-end statutory filings, taxation, regulatory compliance, and client coordination.

title: Compliance Associate
description:
**Company Description**
**The QIMA story**
At QIMA, we’re on a mission to help our clients make products consumers can trust. Working with over 30,000 global brands, retailers, manufacturers and food growers, we are on the ground wherever products are made. We help businesses secure every step of their supply chain with quality inspections, supplier audits, certifications, and lab testing, all powered by our intelligent digital platform.
  
  
Our team of 5,000 QIMers (and counting) across 40 offices and laboratories, are united in our shared passion for innovation and integrity, and guided by our QIMA values in the decisions we make every day. We believe in the work we do, and in making a positive difference in the world. Does this sound like something you’d like to be a part of?
  
  
Our Consumer Goods Division is dedicated to helping brands, retailers and manufacturers worldwide deliver safe, quality and ethically made products to their consumers. Every day at work, our inspectors, auditors, and lab techs use their expertise to help safeguard the products you use every day in your home: from clothes and footwear to toys and baby products, to electronics, appliances, and furniture.
  
  
**Job Description**
You will be expected to:
  
  

* Review Testing, Audit, Inspection report in accordance to the appropriate product standards
* Draft and establish certificates of conformity
* Maintain records in the system
* Coordinate with the technical team to edit products certificates
* Become an expert in a specific field of product technical regulation (to be assigned)
* Manage orders, records for operations
* General customer service includes responding to technical inquiries

**Qualifications**
It could be you if:
  
  

* You have the ability to understand to interpret regulations and standards.
* You have excellent writing, presentation, organizational, interpersonal and communication skills.
* You can demonstrate ability to work well under pressure, learn quickly and seek new assignments, pay attention to details, and meeting tight deadlines.
* You can assess workload and resources accordingly.
* You are quality minded with high attention to detail and proven problem-solving skills.
* Ability to read, write and communicate well in English.

title: Associate Attorney
description:
**Company Description**
Beta is a dynamic, product-based software company focused on engineering high-performance digital solutions for both individuals and organizations. The team designs, builds, and launches proprietary applications that range from intuitive tools for everyday users to scalable platforms for businesses and large enterprises. With a strong emphasis on technical excellence and human-centric design, Beta delivers software that is powerful, secure, and easy to use. The company is committed to creating immediate value and exceptional user experiences through innovation and thoughtful product development.
  
**Role Description**
The Associate Attorney will provide legal support and guidance across Beta’s operations, with a particular focus on employment-related matters and corporate compliance. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing and drafting contracts, policies, and agreements; conducting legal research; and preparing clear, practical legal advice for leadership and internal teams. The role involves advising on labor and employment law issues, supporting negotiations with partners or third parties, and assisting in resolving legal disputes or employee-related matters. The Associate Attorney will collaborate closely with HR, operations, and management to ensure the company’s practices comply with applicable laws and regulations. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Tiruvallur.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Law with practical experience applying legal principles in a corporate or commercial setting.
* Knowledge of Labor and Employment Law, including workplace policies, employee relations, and regulatory compliance.
* Ability to provide clear, concise Legal Advice to non-legal stakeholders and support decision-making processes.
* Proficiency in legal Research to analyze statutes, case law, and regulations relevant to the company’s operations.
* Effective Negotiation skills to support contracts, settlements, and agreements with internal and external parties.
* Bachelor’s degree in Law (LL.B) from an accredited institution; enrollment with the Bar Council and eligibility to practice law.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and organization.
* Ability to work on-site in Tiruvallur, collaborate across teams, and manage multiple matters simultaneously.
* Prior experience in corporate, technology, or startup environments is an advantage.

title: Manager - IR & Admin
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Statutory Approvals – Project & Construction Phase

Coordinate and obtain applicable approvals from DTCP/competent planning authorities, TANGEDCO/TNEB, TNPCB and other relevant government departments.
  
  
Coordinate factory building approvals, factory plan approvals, factory license and other applicable permissions in consultation with the concerned departments.
  
  
Ensure applicable statutory requirements relating to land use, building construction, electrical installations, fire safety, environmental compliance and occupational safety are addressed.
  
  
Coordinate with Civil, Electrical, EHS, Projects and external consultants to secure approvals before commencement of relevant activities.
  
  
Track approval timelines, dependencies and critical-path activities to avoid delays in construction and commissioning.
  
  

* Factory Operational Compliance

Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, factory legislation, industrial relations requirements, environmental regulations and other statutory obligations.
  
  
Coordinate applicable registrations, licenses, renewals, periodic returns, inspections and statutory submissions.
  
  
Maintain a statutory compliance calendar and proactively monitor due dates, validity periods and regulatory changes.
  
  
Coordinate statutory inspections, audits, notices and correspondence with government authorities and ensure timely closure of observations.
  
  
Maintain statutory registers, records, certificates, approvals and supporting documentation for audits and inspections.
  
  

* Industrial Relations & Contract Labour Management

Coordinate contract labour compliance, contractor documentation, labour license requirements, applicable registrations and statutory records.
  
  
Ensure compliance with applicable wage, social security, employment and other labour-related requirements.
  
  
Support workforce-related IR matters, contractor coordination, employee welfare and grievance resolution as required.
  
  

* Administration & Stakeholder Coordination

Act as the single point of contact for statutory and regulatory matters relating to the new facility.
  
  
Manage external statutory consultants and coordinate with internal functions for timely submission of documents and closure of requirements.
  
  
Establish a structured compliance tracker, responsibility matrix and periodic review mechanism.
  
  
Provide periodic updates to management on approval status, pending actions, compliance risks and mitigation plans.
  
  
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
Timely completion of applicable statutory approvals as per the project schedule.
  
  
All required licenses and permissions in place before the relevant construction, commissioning or operational activities.
  
  
100% timely completion of applicable statutory returns, renewals and submissions.
  
  
Zero avoidable statutory non-compliances, penalties or production interruptions attributable to compliance failures.
  
  
Timely closure of statutory inspection observations and audit findings.
